title: Minnich Road NB / SB over I-469 | proposed 2026 rehabilitation
source_note: INDOT B-44533, 62-sheet July 31 2026 proposed rehabilitation, November 2026 letting. This is a proposed design, not a completed construction or verified present-day model.
assumptions: Exterior visualization reconstruction, not an as-built survey, load rating or validated FEM mesh.
No internal reinforcement, prestressing strands, embedded studs, weld beads or fabrication holes. Material colors are visualization choices.
Source pages mix historical removals and proposed work. Only the explicitly named design state is modeled; the separately stored later references do not alter that state.
Buried foundations are hidden by default. Unknown driven pile lengths, terrain and approach-road terminal systems are omitted.
Bearing contact checks verify constructed geometric attachment only; they do not establish surveyed bearing elevations or fabrication tolerances.
Eight girder lines represent two NBI structures in one crossing; the new continuous deck intentionally eliminates the longitudinal joint (sheet 20).
Intermediate columns and caps are provisional envelopes. Original substructure plans are unavailable. No foundations were invented.
Middle-span flange changes and exact end-span taper/upper kink remain simplified; this model is not suitable for FEM without a separate source reconciliation.

parts.name: Proposed continuous deck | former longitudinal joint eliminated
parts.note: Two separately inventoried directional structures share the proposed continuous slab. No invented central deck gap. Revision 1.3: graded with the PVI at Bent 3 (sheet 16); transverse vertices at every flange edge, rail base and a 0.5 m grid, so the soffit follows the profile and crossfall where haunches, diaphragms and rails bear. At the four deck-edge corners the end stops 3 in from the mudwall return (sheet 60 Sections X-X, W-W; sheet 23).

detail_coverage.detail: Both directional girder banks, eight lines, 63 ft overall width and 56 deg 17 min 55 sec skew. Proposed deck removes the former center joint.

End-span depth transitions, sixteen field-splice envelopes, stiffeners and representative bracing. Exact retained flange schedule, upper-flange kink, camber and K-frame detail remain incomplete. Revision 1.3: the end-row frames frame_0_0_* and frame_3_1_* are the drawn MC 18x42.7 channel diaphragms nearest the end bents (sheets 25-28, 30-31, 33); the other end-span diaphragms, K-frames and cross-frames are represented by one X frame per bay near Bents 2 and 4.
Cast-in-place end diaphragms at Bents 1 and 5, 2 ft normal to the bent, Girder 1 to Girder 8, encasing the girder ends. Construction joint, chamfers, shear studs and reinforcement are not modelled.

Forty bearing envelopes. The sixteen end-bent bearings follow sheet 34 (S5-B pad, bearing top plate, tabulated shim, flange connection plate) and sit on the end-bent caps at the sheet 23 levels; the 21 pedestals are at the intermediate bents. Retained intermediate shoes are envelopes only.

Existing end-bent caps 3 ft 6 in wide with tops at the drawn seat levels (flat on the long bank, four steps on the short bank) and the new mudwalls of Section A-A, 3 in behind the deck end. Cap depth and length, wingwalls, coatings and reinforcement are not drawn or not modelled. The mudwall ends return toward the wingwalls as sheet 23 draws them; the existing wingwalls are not modelled.
Support envelopes only: original substructure plans were absent from the public package. Column arrangement and dimensions must not be used for analysis or quantity takeoff.

FC rails and six RCBA panels. Detailed wingwall, TFC/guardrail transitions, stepped approach edge offsets and drainage are unfinished. RCBA inner edges rest on the mudwall ledge with the 2 in seat thickening and turn onto the mudwall returns at the deck-edge corners; the four RCBA extensions along the wingwalls are modelled, the wingwalls are not (sheets 23, 24, 56, 58, 60).
Unknown foundations, road/site surfaces, drainage troughs, guardrail terminals, all connection holes and full retained substructure details.
